20166.long_desc: Immerse yourself in vivid visuals with the 16.6 Inch (4:1) 1080p LCD Monitor. This expansive display offers a generous viewing area, perfect for Work, Entertainment, and Arcade Applications. The features of the new monitor are; - VGA & HDMI input, for RGB input, please use the Arcooda RGB board - Extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount inside the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine. - Clear Display: 16.6 inch display for a clear and immersive viewing experience with a resolution of 1920x470 pixels - Compact Design: Its small size makes it perfect for space-saving setups or portable use. - Versatility: Multiple inputs including HDMI, VGA, and 9 pin Molex - Built-in Digital Media Player : Connect a USB drive and play an image slideshow, static image or video(s) - supported video formats for the usb media player include :- MOV H264 (AVC) , MOV MPEG, MP$ H.264 (AVC) and
